text:
maya: Heads up — vendor just flagged a 2–3 day delay on APAC A100 racks. Can someone check our quotas/standby options? Need confirmation for next week's dedicated-pool smoke tests. cc @devin @lucas

devin: Which region exactly? asia-southeast1 or apac-northeast1?

lucas: Vendor message mentioned APAC broadly, asked for preferred zone. We prefer asia-southeast1 if possible.

anita: FYI finance paused one PO last night pending final sign-off. That might block full shipment allocation.

devin: Doing a quick quota check now: `gcloud compute quotas list --project=redwood-inference --filter="metric:GPUS" --regions=asia-southeast1`

devin: Quick result — shows 8/16 A100 quota used. But GCP aggregates GPU quotas; need exact SKU mapping for vendor-type A100s. Opening a cloud support ticket.

lucas: Vendor replied — can partial ship 4 units tomorrow, remainder delayed. Accept partial or hold? :thinking_face: 

maya: If 4 covers the canary + smoke, take partial. What's minimum for canary?

anita: Canary needs 2 nodes (1 GPU each) to validate end-to-end. Dedicated target is 20 GPUs, so partial won't finish provisioning but should unblock tests.

devin: Options: 1) accept 4 + borrow 2 from demo pool for parity smoke, 2) reschedule dedicated pool rollout, 3) use preemptible fallback for some lanes. Leaning to 1.

lucas: +1 for 1. I'll try to reserve 2 GPUs from demo pool now. @ops-bot can you run a quick reserve?

ops-bot: reserve request received for 2 GPUs from pool 'demo-standby' — processing...

ops-bot: done — 2 GPUs reserved until 2024-08-18T04:00Z for ticket #INF-4721

maya: Great. Devin, can you update the terraform PR to deschedule long-running training from demo pool and add a fallback route in rollout config?

devin: On it. Also opening a quota increase request in eu-west for parallel tests later this week. Will paste ticket link when created.

lucas: Asked vendor for manifest + serials for shipped units, will post when it arrives.

anita: I'll follow up with finance to expedite the PO sign-off for the remaining units.

maya: OK — plan: accept partial shipment, borrow 2 demo GPUs to cover smoke, queue quota bump for eu-west, and update PR for fallback. Moving to async — ping here if anything changes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
